title: Model witnessed European compact OBJ animations
changes: Add a source-authenticated lossless compact OBJ animation model for the five caller-witnessed source spans without imposing guest selector bounds.
validation: The corrected isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed byte and boundary reconstruction, JSON and tamper checks, and original count, frame and list-reader prefixes; protected inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: An initial Wine shape check failed and was corrected. Managed runtime publication, ordinary use, the unwitnessed sequence and lists, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
